spans.text: Galatea Corporation has recently announced a key breakthrough in the development of an anti-Collapse serum.
This serum is said to be highly effective in suppressing symptoms in cases of moderate to severe infections and can essentially cure patients with mild infections.
We have interviewed renowned medical expert Mrs. Gray regarding this formulation.
Thank you very much for making the time to attend this interview today, Mrs. Gray.
We wish to learn more about "Idunn", the new anti-Collapse serum that Galatea is about to distribute, in the interview today.
Idunn is being marketed as an affordable but highly effective drug. According to the spokesperson of your company, it is completely unlike any other existing drugs.
People are having misgivings mostly because of this. How would you respond to such doubts?
Here's my response—don't worry, I will never exploit the trust that my patients have in me.
I may have a bit of a reputation, but I'm still only one among all my fellow physicians.
My confidence in Galatea's new product is based on its own merits. I simply wish more people will benefit from its success and receive better medical treatment.
Thanks to Galatea's marketing campaign, Idunn's alleged effects are no secret in Berlin.
The drug has indeed yielded some remarkable results in clinical trials, but it still has to go through a lot of standard procedures before official distribution can begin?
We have absolute confidence in passing the rigorous vetting process.
Please wait patiently for dawn to break.
Do not fall before the first ray of sunlight pierces the darkness.
I see. Thank you once again for attending this interview.
That concludes today's news. This is Aktuelle Kamera, brought to you by the DRF.
